newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks slighly stronger in dormant London.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks slighly stronger in dormant London.

text.p: Most Japanese shares were slightly firmer in London on follow through buying after the benchmark average finished at a high for 1997.
By 1322 GMT, the Nikkei 50 share index was up 4.19 points to 1,606.84.
Dealers said light buying in blue chips dominated otherwise thin trading, with Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, Sharp Corp, Sony Corp and Toshiba Corp advancing.
They noted some profit-taking in Hitachi Ltd.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 index rose 48.40 points to 20,611.56.
